reason: I don't work with any creators. My customers come from regulars, my WhatsApp group and Google reviews, so there's nothing for this to count. Even free, it's one more thing for my counter staff to handle, and I get nothing back from it.
objection: Who are you? You're a new startup with a small team, and you could be gone in six months. I'm also not going to start paying Instagram people just so I have something to track.
would_change_my_mind: If a creator my regulars already follow offered to post about my place and brought me the link themselves, and another café owner I know told me the counts matched their bill book, I'd try the free part.
